// === Tab: mySketch ===
// Genuary 2024:1 - Particles, lots of them
//
// Maybe not really particles, and not a lot of them either

let cw, ch
let ringSize
let nRings = 10

function setup () {
  cw = windowWidth
  ch = windowHeight
  // Round cw and ch to multiples of 4
  cw = cw - (cw % 4)
  ch = ch - (ch % 4)
  createCanvas(cw, ch, WEBGL)
  colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100, 100)
  noFill()
  ringSize = min(cw, ch) / 4
  rings = []
  for (let i = 0; i < nRings; i++) {
    let angle = i * TAU / nRings
    let nCubes = 20
    rings.push(new Ring([
      cos(angle) * ringSize,
      sin(angle) * ringSize,
      0
    ], ringSize, nCubes, ringSize / 10))
  }
}

let cycleSpeed = 0.01
function draw () {
  background(0, 0, 20)
  orbitControl()

  push()
  translate(0, 0, -ringSize / 2)
  rotateX(PI / 2)
  rotateZ(frameCount * cycleSpeed)

  noFill()
  for (let i = 0; i < nRings; i++) {
    let ring = rings[i]
    var angle = i * TAU / nRings
    push()
    translate(...ring.center)
    rotateX(PI/2)
    rotateY(angle)
    if (i % 2 === 0) {
      rotateZ(frameCount * 0.02)
    } else {
      rotateZ(-frameCount * 0.02)
    }
    let za = map((frameCount * cycleSpeed) % TAU, 0, 1, 0, 360) / 2
    let hue = ((i * 360 / nRings) + za) % 360
    strokeWeight(map(sin(frameCount * 0.1 + i), -1, 1, 3, 5))
    rings[i].draw(hue)
    pop()
  }
  pop()
}

class Ring {
  constructor(center, radius, nCubes, cubeSize) {
    this.center = center
    this.radius = radius
    this.nCubes = nCubes
    this.cubeSize = cubeSize
    this.cubes = []
    this.build()
  }

  build () {
    let cubeSize = this.cubeSize
    let radius = this.radius
    var nCubes = this.nCubes
    for (let i = 0; i < nCubes; i++) {
      var angle = i * TAU / nCubes
      let cubeCenter = [
        cos(angle) * radius,
        sin(angle) * radius,
        0
      ]
      let cube = { cubeCenter, cubeSize }
      this.cubes.push(cube)
    }
  }

  p (x, y, z) {
    push()
    translate(x, y, z)
    sphere(this.radius / 100)
    pop()
  }

  draw (hue) {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.nCubes; i++) {
      var cube = this.cubes[i]
      let { cubeCenter, cubeSize } = cube
      let [x, y, z] = cubeCenter
      push()
      translate(x, y, z)
      let newHue = (hue + (i * 360 / this.nCubes)) % 360
      fill(newHue, 50, 100, 100)
      noStroke()
      rotateX(frameCount * 0.01)
      rotateY(frameCount * 0.02)
      rotateZ(frameCount * 0.04)
      this.p(cubeSize / 2, 0, 0)
      this.p(-cubeSize / 2, 0, 0)
      this.p(0, cubeSize / 2, 0)
      this.p(0, -cubeSize / 2, 0)
      this.p(0, 0, cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(0, 0, -cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(-cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(-cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(-cubeSize / 2, cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2)
      this.p(-cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2, -cubeSize / 2)
      pop()
    }
  }
}
